metadata.title: Every product correctly rounded: bit-reproducible LoRA training of a 379-billion-parameter mixture of experts from a laptop's disk
metadata.description:
Floating-point training is not a function of its inputs. GPU kernels choose their reduction order by shape, backward passes accumulate with atomics, and the same data in another batch, on another GPU or with another library gives other gradients. Recent batch-invariant and deterministic kernels fix one order per kernel: a run becomes repeatable on the same software and hardware, but its result is still defined by an implementation. We take the other route: every linear map of the forward and of the backward pass returns the correctly rounded value of its exact sum, a number defined by the mathematics alone. The products run exactly on INT8 tensor cores from digit planes of BF16 and FP8 operands; the rounding is certified, and every output the certificate leaves open is recomputed exactly on the CUDA cores or, as a last resort, in a 2560-bit host superaccumulator. Gradients through FP8 expert weights are exact, never quantized.

Applied to rank-16 LoRA (alpha = 32) on the query and value projections of all 61 layers of Jais-3-375B-A23B-FP8 (379 billion parameters, 192 FP8 experts per MoE layer, a 391 GB checkpoint) streamed from the NVMe disk of a laptop with a 12 GB GPU once per forward and once per backward, a step of 8 x 1024 tokens takes 27-29 minutes (1603-1716 s over steps 22-125). The step does not depend on how rows are grouped into products (4096 or 40 rows), on the number of threads (24 or 7), on interruption (a resumed run is byte-identical), on where an expert's rows are gathered, or on which of three generations of our product kernels computes it; since step 5 no output has been used uncertified. Five hand-written backward formulas agree with central differences of their FP64 forward to 5.05e-7; finite differences through four layers (slopes 0.93-0.97) and the loss change of real updates through all 61 layers agree with the backward. On a corpus of 191.9 million tokens from 21 public institutions of Kosovo, the held-out loss falls from 1.5102 before the first update to 1.4066 after 100 updates and stays within 1.4066-1.4165 through step 125.

Përmbledhje (shqip). Çdo shumëzim matricash i trajnimit, përpara dhe prapa, jep vlerën e rrumbullakosur saktë të shumës së saktë, i llogaritur mbi tensor core-t INT8 dhe i certifikuar. Me këtë u trajnua LoRA mbi Jais-3-375B-A23B-FP8 (379 miliardë parametra, 391 GB) nga disku i një laptopi me GPU 12 GB; hapi nuk varet nga grupimi i rreshtave, numri i fijeve, ndërprerja apo versioni i kernel-ave.
